text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm. So the rescue operation was a failure...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...! I see,
I understand, I understand completely!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What you wished for was a tragedy!
Which is to say, a tragic tale!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It feels like a metaphor warning that touching me, the sun itself, will scorch away one's wings!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you souls beyond the glass...!
Forgive me for possessing such sinful radiance...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
